weakness_class: F115 Security controls bypass or absence
trigger: Origin header containing the configured origin as a substring (e.g. https://example.com.attacker.com vs configured https://example.com)
exploit_path: Weakened isOriginAllowed string check (indexOf instead of ===) accepts attacker origin; it is reflected into Access-Control-Allow-Origin, enabling authenticated cross-origin reads (CWE-942)
notes: Host is isOriginAllowed string branch; strict twin rejects evil origin, vulnerable twin accepts it
